scope: Imported unqueued records acquire local membership only through the existing guarded local enqueue or review transition, including confirmation of its actual authorized set_status intent. Confirmation of update_prose and settlement of remote status/prose leave membership false. Preserve already queued membership, nonimported behavior, genuine observations, existing public schemas and remote acknowledgement facts.

case_added.basis: R04 explicit local queue admission; the lead reviewed and approved this correction
controls: Imported remote Todo is revised through exact writing and authorized scope decision, then its actual update_prose is confirmed through the authored HTTP provider. It remains unqueued, with no attempt/resource, and direct reserve and start cannot grant work.
A real recorded authorized remote observation settles Todo without establishing local membership. Actual reserve/start remain denied, without a provider In Progress effect or new attempt/resource.

After either path, existing explicit enqueue with exact decision and fresh queue-purpose source readback succeeds once; an actual reservation can then proceed. Same-key enqueue replay has identical result and no duplicate queue event, operation, attempt or provider effect.

Imported Backlog uses the existing authorized set_status Todo intent and exact provider confirmation to establish membership. An authorized local In Review to Todo review transition also retains this confirmation behavior.
Previously queued imported records remain queued after prose confirmation and remote settlement. Equivalent nonimported confirmation/settlement behavior remains unchanged.
